decision: The complete q8192/out512 boundary passes at55453.937ms, compared with56604.0518ms for the qualified compact-PV baseline. Every token, callback and first logit matches GB10. Keep16-lane DPP correction with four K16 groups staged before ordered accumulation. Native73782 adversarial dots and partial tiles match independent CPU arithmetic. Disassembly confirms eight operand loads for the K64 body with no scratch operations; static instructions are not throughput. One native microtiming is negative and invalid. One run per product configuration does not establish repeatability. Broader contexts, renewed package/HTTP/soak and immutable performance remain open.
